column1: # opcode -> subsystem, from the normalised STEM shared by its named senders'
# classes in payload_layouts.tsv. Generated by tools/opcode_subsystems.py.
# An opcode appears only when >=2 named senders share a stem of >=8 characters.
# Generic module attributions (GObjPC, CMainProcess, ...) are excluded: they say
# where a function lives, not which subsystem owns the opcode.
# strength = how many named senders share that stem.
